en: (on the way down after being sent flying)

zh: 连续按攻击键或防御键

en: This uses MP to force surrounding enemies away.
Uses MP. You will avoid being sent flying and attack foes in range.
zh: 消耗MP，避免被击飞，并攻击范围内的敌人。

en: You will avoid being sent flying and attack the assailant behind you.
zh: 避免被击飞，并攻击身后的袭击者。

en: (right after being struck from behind on the ground)
- Using it repeatedly saps MP, but lets you move about unharmed
zh: －连续使用会消耗MP，但可安全移动

en: - It lets you cancel your basic attacks
- You are invulnerable at the start of the backstep
zh: －后撤步起始时处于无敌状态

en: Using the backstep has certain advantages:
Rapidly tap the directional pad/attack buttons to regain control.
zh: 快速连按方向键或攻击键，恢复控制。

en: Just like a normal stun, this causes you to lose control of your character.
zh: 与普通眩晕一样，这会让你失去对角色的控制。

en: If you try to use magic without enough MP, you will suffer "mental distress."
zh: MP不足时强行使用魔法，会陷入“精神失衡”。

en: However, you will gradually recover HP while stunned.
zh: 但眩晕期间，HP会逐渐恢复。

en: Rapidly tap the directional pad/attack buttons to break out of the stun.
zh: 快速连按方向键或攻击键，可挣脱眩晕。

en: Stuns cause you to lose control of your character for a set amount of time.
zh: 眩晕会让你在一段时间内失去对角色的控制。

en: You will be stunned if you take a certain amount of damage in a row.
zh: 短时间内连续受到一定伤害，就会眩晕。

en: In Story Mode, you also recover some MP for finishing scenes in each stage.
zh: 剧情模式中，完成各关卡的场景，也可恢复部分MP。

en: The more hits you land, the more MP you will recover.
zh: 命中次数越多，恢复的MP就越多。

en: - Wait for it to gradually recover (to a point)
zh: －等待MP逐渐恢复（恢复至一定程度）

en: - Land direct attacks of 2 hits or more
zh: －用直接攻击连续命中2次以上

en: You can recover MP in the following ways:
He will mercilessly lash out at nearby foes.
zh: 他会无情地猛攻附近的敌人。

en: He will stop in place and cease all activity.
zh: 他会停留原地，停止一切行动。

en: He will stand behind you and await further orders.
zh: 他会站在你身后，等候进一步指令。

en: He will seek out foes and attack with his sword.
zh: 他会寻找敌人，挥剑攻击。

en: He will stand in front of you and block attacks.
zh: 他会站在你前方，抵挡攻击。

en: You can issue the following commands:
Once the Undead Hero joins you in Story Mode, you can command him.
zh: 不死英雄在剧情模式中加入后，你便可向他下令。

en: Decreases the magical damage you take.
Decreases the physical damage you take.
Leveling up also earns you bonus points, which can be funneled into your stats:
zh: 升级还会获得奖励点数，可分配至各项属性：

en: Gain enough EXP and you will "level up" on the spot, increasing your Max HP/MP.
zh: 获得足够经验后，会立即升级，HP和MP上限随之提高。

en: You can earn EXP in the following ways:
zh: 可通过以下方式获得经验：

en: Dash and hold the directional pad
Note: Some controls may not apply to every character.
zh: 注意：部分操作并非适用于所有角色。
显示的按键为默认设置。
